original_measured_bundle_completion_plan.semantics: estimate for completing every scheduled step, not a time-based partial curriculum

completion_plan.optimizer_forecast_basis: one cold allocation step plus maximum measured warm steps
completion_plan.semantics: estimate for completing every scheduled step, not a time-based partial curriculum
completion_plan.limitations: sampled scheduled maxima with margin, not a mathematical upper bound; cold stress checks memory separately; future batches/contention can differ

native_measurement_reuse_audit.semantics: Reuse native measurement without another GPU run; only CPU completion arithmetic changed. Original raw forecast remains immutable.

h100.limitations: Complete-run estimates from zero-update backward and disposable optimizer/IO probes; not observed full training or a runtime guarantee. Post-training evaluation time is separate and unmeasured.

ordinary.scope: production sample and cold largest-row language/type/route/flag strata including CPU preparation

all_stress_completion_plan.limitations: measured cold/warm stress and isolated optimizer/save; future hardware contention can differ
all_stress_completion_plan.semantics: estimate for completing every scheduled step, not a time-based partial curriculum

exploration_budget.semantics: Reservations and unreconciled remote prior entries are conservative limits, not an invoice. Earlier local dated audit remains unchanged. No main training is charged or performed.

remaining_trained_validation: independent EN/KO/JA regression after full training
